item.tib: gsas mkhar spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las/ zhi ba a dkar don gyi thig le'i bsgrub pa
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs a dkar don gyi sgrub pa/ g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung don bcud du dril ba/ man ngag don dam pa mchog gi sgrab pa zhes bya ba/ 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum gyis gtan la phab cing / dbal gshen stag la me 'bar la brgyud do/ des lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi la brgyud do/ de nas bar gyi gdung rabs rim pa brgyud nas/ mkhas pa mi bzhi yi ring la g.yung drung gi bon rab tu dar zhing gnyen par bzhugs te/ dus res shig na nam mkha' stong pa la rlung gi 'khor los dbang bsgyar te/ bstan pa dar nub kyi dus su bla chen dran pa nam mkhas srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du gtad cing / ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dbal gshen khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i 'od zer las spral pa'i bu/ dbal gshen stag la'i thugs sras/ dbra khyung sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la srid pa'i rgyal mos mngon sum du zhal bstan cing snyan du brgyud pa lags so//
